bodyFields.o: sort: 1 Featured(default), 5 Name A-Z, 6 Name Z-A, 10 Price low-high, 11 Price high-low, 15 Newest. Unknown value (999, abc) silently falls back to default
bodyFields.s: page size: UI offers 12,24(default),36,48,72,120; arbitrary ints accepted (s=2, s=3 work); s=abc or s=1000 -> default (all); s=0 -> HTTP 500
bodyFields.i: 1-based page index; i=0 / i=-1 -> page 1; i beyond last page -> last page (i=99 returned the last page); pager markup: select#artlist-action-page data-qname=i, a.btn-pager-prev / a.btn-pager-next, 'Page N of M'
bodyFields.v: view mode: list | grid. v=list renders <div class='artlist artlist-lines'> instead of artlist-grid. PERSISTED server side in ASP.NET_SessionId session: later requests without v keep list until v=grid
bodyFields.p: price facet 'from~to' (e.g. ~25, 10~25, 25~); %7e is the encoded ~. UI presets ~10 ~25 ~50 ~100 ~250 ~500 ~1000 plus custom From/to boxes (#price-range-from, #price-range-to, button #btn-custom-price-range). Non-numeric value ignored
bodyFields.r: min rating facet 1..4 (4 = 4 stars and more). r=5 -> empty list; r=0 ignored
bodyFields.d: delivery time id facet: 1 available and ready to ship, 2 '2-5 woking days' (sic), 3 '7 working days'; multiple comma separated (d=1,2). Unknown id -> empty list
bodyFields.a: a=True 'Include Out of Stock'; a=true also accepted; a=False same as unset
